hard_constraints_summary: This story must avoid prophecy and chosen one tropes while including Mara, a woman who brokers memories through a decaying AI archive in a flooded mining town.
soft_constraints_summary: The story should have a horror tone, focus on themes of memory manipulation, dehumanization, resilience, and technological decay, while keeping the setting in a flooded mining town.
brief: A quiet horror story set in a flooded mining town, about a woman named Mara who brokers other people's memories through a decaying AI archive; no prophecy, no chosen one.
